class.name: OpenXRSpatialContainerState
class.brief_description: An object representing the state of an OpenXR spatial container.
class.description: The [OpenXRSpatialContainerState] object holds information about the current state of a spatial container, including its visibility, interactability, and bounds mode.

method.name: get_bounds_mode
method.description: Returns the current bounds mode of the spatial container.

method.name: is_interactable
method.description: Returns the current interactability of the spatial container.

method.name: is_visible
method.description: Returns the current visibility state of the spatial container.

constants.constant: The spatial container is in bounded mode.
The spatial container is in immersive mode.
